name: Qatar National Bank Alahly
source: QNB Egypt press release, financial results FY25, consolidated income statement (EGP million)
source_note: Consolidated columns of the bank income statement, in EGP absolute (release prints EGP million). Revenue is the bank net banking income (58,088 mn FY25) and Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed Gross operating income (47,044 mn FY25); a bank has no Cost of Sales or Gross Profit line, and neither row is invented here. The printed lines tie: Gross operating income less Net cost of risk equals Net income before tax, less Income tax equals Net Profit. No EPS: the release does not print earnings per share and no share count is stated in it, so the panel shows an honest dash rather than a derived figure.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Gross operating income as printed in the release
